correctness.rationale: Cyclic cubic ramification gives genus five for t^5 != 6. A proven five-element differential basis yields a fully explicit Cartier matrix; exact symbolic computation validates all coefficients and minors. The twisted two-step blocks establish stable rank four off t^5=2; a degree-five field computation establishes the exceptional stable rank two via rank-stable idempotence and all Frobenius conjugates. The t=0 matrix vanishes, and Kummer irreducibility gives exact extension-field counts.

value.rationale: The pencil naturally deforms a documented superspecial trigonal genus-five curve, holding a seven-branch cover structure fixed. Its nonzero-fiber a-number remains one while stable rank changes on exactly one degree-five closed point. That interaction is a complete geometric and arithmetic invariant of a natural family, with nontrivial implications for deformation behavior and finite-field parameter distributions.
